title: December (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 96bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Australian summer Christmas family seasons warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
December comes with heat in Western Australia's June-reversed way
The jacarandas all in purple and the children have their say
School is finishing, the garden's at its fullest before the dry
December is the month the whole year builds itself toward and by

[Pre-Chorus]
My mother made December feel like it was meant for us
The table set, the garden done, no argument, no fuss

[Chorus]
December, December
Longer days and shorter nights and everything I remember
The smell of sunscreen and the sound of the back door screen
December is the month that holds between what was and has been
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The nights are warm enough to sit outside until eleven
The sky above is very clear and full of something heaven
Adjacent — not religious — just the feeling that the air
Is bigger than you thought it was and you've been breathing better there

[Bridge]
The children are grown now and December shifts in shape
But it still carries something of that original landscape
The garden after Christmas dinner, everyone out there
December in the garden and the warm December air

[Outro]
December knows… the heat knows… the garden knows…
The gardens still growing
